questions.question: Calculate E deg for: Zn | Zn^2⁺ || Cu^2⁺ | Cu. E deg (Zn^2⁺/Zn) = -0.76V, E deg (Cu^2⁺/Cu) = +0.34V. Is reaction spontaneous?

points.text: E deg _cell = 0.34 - (-0.76) = +1.10 V > 0 -> spontaneous. Zn oxidised (anode), Cu^2⁺ reduced (cathode). Reaction: Zn + Cu^2⁺ -> Zn^2⁺ + Cu
